messages:
leo: noticing elevated decode errors after the midnight roll: embla-quant-v1 started returning "decode_failure: invalid token sequence" for ~0.6% of requests in eu-central. anyone else seeing this?

deploybot: Deploybot: anomaly alert for model=embla-quant-v1 region=eu-central at 00:12 UTC. No pins detected. (bot)

sre_anya: looks correlated with runtime 2.20 unpin earlier today. traces show `decode_prefetch` returning truncated buffers on multi-chunk requests. attaching sample trace to incident ticket.

runtime_lead: I can repro with long multi-turn: `./smoke --model embla-quant-v1 --turns 50 --runtime 2.20`. hypothesis: kernel reorder in 2.20 + SDK keepalive extension can cause partial kv fetches.

sdk_patch: SDK 5.0 toggled prefetch batching by default. we can flip it per-model while we validate. prefer SDK-level soft-pin to avoid global runtime rollback.

leo: propose soft-pin SDK to 4.9.7 for embla-quant-v1 in eu-central for 90m, retain 5% canary on 5.0. rollback criteria: if decode_error_rate >0.3% for 10m escalate to full pin.

release_czar: approved. owners: sdk-team + runtime. deploybot run `/deploybot pin-sdk --model embla-quant-v1 --sdk 4.9.7 --regions eu-central --duration 90m --canary 5%`

deploybot: command accepted. executing pin... pin applied at 7965432140 :white_check_mark:

sre_anya: running perf and tailing metrics. will shout here at +10m with delta.

runtime_lead: also opening a hotfix branch to add a safeguard in runtime 2.20 that rejects partial kv fetches; if we see OOMs or lat regressions after SDK pin we may need an immediate runtime revert.

leo: release note draft: "Temporary SDK pin to 4.9.7 for embla-quant-v1 in eu-central due to intermittent decode failures observed after SDK 5.0 + runtime 2.20 unpin. 90m soft-pin, 5% canary retained, owners: SDK & Runtime."

release_czar: staying on this thread. opsbot will post a summary when metrics stabilize or if escalation triggers.
